description: This file defines the entity class 'BuzzLikeOnShare' using Doctrine ORM annotations. It models a 'like' action on a shared buzz post, including properties such as share, employee, and timestamp, with associated getters and setters.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShare
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' on a shared buzz post, with properties for ID, share, employee, and liked timestamp, utilizing ORM mappings and traits for helper functions.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the like record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the like record.

methods.name: getShare
methods.description: Returns the BuzzShare entity associated with this like.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Assigns a BuzzShare entity to this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who liked the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee who liked the share.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the like was made in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the liked timestamp to the current UTC time.
